blocks.text: Computed Tomography, jise aam taur par CT-Scan kehte hain, medical imaging ka tareeqa hai jo X-ray technology ko computer processing se jor kar body ke andar ki structures (banawaton) ki high-resolution (bohat saaf) cross-sectional (aar-paar kati hui) aur 3D images banata hai. Yeh bimariyon ki diagnosis (pehchan), andar ki injuries (choton) ka pata lagane aur treatment ko guide karne (rasta dikhane) ke liye khaas taur par useful (mufeed) hai. Aam X-ray body ki flat (chapti, 2D) image deti hai jis mein haddiyan aur organs (aza) ek doosre ke oopar aa jate hain (overlap), is liye alag alag hisse saaf nahi dikhte. Maslan Fig. 20.7 (seene ki X-ray) mein aage aur peeche ki ribs (pasliyan) alag pehchanna mushkil hai kyunke woh ek doosre ke oopar nazar aati hain. Is problem ka hal CT scan (Computed Tomography) hai.

CT scanner body ke ek hi hisse (section) ki mukhtalif angles (zawiyon) se bohat si X-ray images leta hai. Computer in ko jor kar body ki ek detailed (tafseeli) cross-sectional (slice, yani patli tah) image banata hai. Phir scanner body ke saath thora aage khisak kar agle slice ke liye yahi process dohrata hai. Aakhir mein computer tamam slices ko jor kar andar ki structure ki 3D image banata hai.

blocks.alt: Mareez couch par X-ray detectors ki ring ke andar leta hai. Ring ke neeche X-ray tube se X-ray beam mareez ke tumour (rasoli) se guzar kar oopar 'activated' X-ray detector tak jati hai. Labels: Patient on couch, Activated X-ray detector, X-ray detectors, X-ray, Tumour, X-ray tube.
blocks.caption: Figure 20.8: CT scanner ka operation (kaam) (kitab ki Figure 20.8 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: X-ray tube ek taraf se X-ray beam bhejti hai; beam mareez ki body (aur tumour) se guzar kar saamne wale detector par parti hai, jo 'activated' (laal) dikhaya gaya hai. Tube mareez ke gird ghoomti hai, is liye har angle se image milti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Fig. 20.8 mein beam ko 'gamma ray' aur detectors ko 'gamma ray detectors' likha hai, aur ring ke dono taraf laal (activated) detectors hain. CT scanner mein gamma rays nahi, X-rays istemal hoti hain: ek taraf X-ray tube aur saamne detector hota hai. Is liye hamari drawing mein 'X-ray', 'X-ray detectors' aur neeche 'X-ray tube' likha hai.
Kitab ke mutabiq CT machine mein X-ray tube mareez ke gird ghoomti hai jab ke detectors apni jagah fixed rehte hain. Is setup se har taraf se poori information (maloomat) jama hoti hai (Fig. 20.8).

blocks.title: Aasan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab ki baat ek design (detectors ki fixed ring) ki hai. Zyada tar modern (naye) CT scanners mein detectors bhi X-ray tube ke saamne wali taraf us ke saath ghoomte hain. Dono designs mein asal baat ek hai: X-rays har angle se body ke aar-paar naapi jati hain.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: CT-scanner Sir Godfrey Hounsfield (England) aur Allan Cormack (South Africa) ne 1970s ke shuru mein invent (ijad) kiya. Is invention par dono ko 1979 mein Physiology or Medicine ka Nobel Prize mila.
Computed tomography naam in lafzon se bana:

items: Computed: computer data process karta hai.
Tomography: Greek lafz tomos se, jis ka matlab hai slice (patli tah).
Axial: scan body ke axis (body ke beech se guzarne wali lakeer) ke saath liya jata hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: CT-scan seconds mein saikron slices (images) bana leta hai, jaise digital seb (apple) ko tah dar tah chheela ja raha ho. CT-scan stroke (falij) ko shuru hone ke chand minute mein pakar sakta hai, jo jaan bachane wale ilaj ke liye bohat zaroori hai.

Is tarah doctors andar ke organs, haddiyon ya tissues ka saaf aur detailed view (manzar) dekhte hain. Fig. 20.9 mein ek bachche ka CT scan ho raha hai aur monitor par sar (head) ki cross-sectional image hai. Is tareeqe ko Computed Axial Tomography (CT scan) kehte hain kyunke computer scanning ko control karta hai, data jama karta hai aur use images mein badalta hai. X-ray tube mareez ki body ke gird ghoom kar mukhtalif angles se images leti hai, jin se body ke detailed cross-sectional slices bante hain. Lafz "tomography" Greek lafz tomos (slice) se hai, jo batata hai ke body ki image layer by layer (tah dar tah) banti hai.

CT scans aam X-rays ke muqable mein kai important (aham) faide dete hain. Akeli X-ray image jaldi banti aur useful hai, lekin sirf flat, two-dimensional (2D) view deti hai. CT scans three-dimensional (3D) images dete hain jin se doctors body ke andar organs, haddiyon aur doosri structures ka size, shape aur exact location (theek jagah) dekh sakte hain. Is se milti julti density wale tissues bhi alag pehchane ja sakte hain. Maslan CT scan tumour (rasoli) ki position aur size saaf dikha sakta hai, jis se treatment mein high-energy X-rays ya gamma rays ka target (nishana) theek lagaya ja sakta hai. Lekin yaad rahe ke CT scan mein X-rays istemal hoti hain jo ionizing radiation hain. Radiation ka amount (miqdar) nisbatan kam hai magar mareez ke liye thora risk (khatra) phir bhi hai. CT scan ki dose (radiation ki miqdar) scan ki type par depend karti hai: sar ka CT taqreeban 2 mSv (natural background radiation ke taqreeban 8 mahine) aur seene ya pet ka CT taqreeban 7-10 mSv (taqreeban 2-3 saal). Is liye doctors khaas precautions (ehtiyat) karte hain, khaas taur par pregnant khawateen aur pehle se bimar mareezon ke scan mein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke CT scan ki average dose saal bhar ki natural background radiation ka taqreeban ek-tihai (one-third), ya chaar lambi hawai flights (parwazon) ke barabar hai. Asal dose kahin zyada hai: sar ka CT taqreeban 2 mSv aur seene ya pet ka 7-10 mSv, jab ke saal bhar ki background taqreeban 2.4-3 mSv aur ek lambi flight sirf 0.03-0.1 mSv deti hai. Kitab ke dono comparisons (muqable) aapas mein bhi nahi milte. Isi liye CT sirf tab kiya jata hai jab us ka faida thore risk se zyada ho.

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text: CT scanners mukhtalif angles se bohat si X-ray images le kar body ka ek 2D cross-section banate hain. Jab yeh slices jore jate hain to cake ki layers (tahon) ki tarah ek 3D model ban jata hai.

blocks.prompt: CT scan woh tumour kaise dikha sakta hai jo aam X-ray mein chhupa reh jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Aam X-ray mein beam ke raaste mein aane wali har cheez ka absorption (jazb hona) jud jata hai, is liye structures ek doosre ke oopar aa jati hain (overlap). CT ek slice ko bohat se angles se naapta hai aur computer slice ke har point ka absorption alag nikalta hai. Is se oopar neeche wali structures alag ho jati hain aur density ke chhote farq bhi nazar aate hain.

items: CT: X-ray tube mareez ke gird ghoom kar har angle se image leti hai; computer 2D slices bana kar 3D mein jorta hai.
Naam: Computed, Tomography (tomos = slice), Axial; Hounsfield aur Cormack (Nobel 1979).
Faide: 3D view, overlap karti structures alag, tumour ki position aur size.
X-rays ionizing hain: CT ki dose aam X-ray se kaafi zyada, is liye precautions.
